prompts.sarah: A highly detailed, sharp full-body game character sprite of a slender young woman who looks about twenty-five, standing and facing the viewer, the whole figure from head to boots in frame, on a plain white background in even, soft studio light. Her long hair is iridescent: a balayage that blends cobalt blue into purple, with shifting magenta-violet highlights and a metallic, photovoltaic sheen, a faint fine grid pattern glinting in the highlights like light across a thin film; every strand is crisp and highly detailed, and neither colour wins, the blue and the purple trade places along each strand. Her eyes glow violet. She has the beginning of a smirk. She has a fine-boned oval face and fair skin. She wears a matte black tactical bodysuit with faceted armor plates at the forearms and shoulders, a glowing violet nuclear core marked with a radiation trefoil set in a small chest plate at her sternum, a holster and gun belt at her hips, and flat black boots. Clean, readable silhouette.
